column1: # Single source of truth for the local DBeaver DB cockpit (see dbeaver-db-access doc).
# Both db-forward-all.sh and gen-dbeaver-sources.py read this file.
# Columns (TAB-separated): localport  namespace  service  remoteport  engine  env  label  secret
#   engine : postgres | mariadb | clickhouse   (DBeaver driver to use)
#   env    : prod | dev   (prod => DBeaver Connection type=Production: red header + read-only default)
#   service: CNPG clusters expose <cluster>-rw (follows the primary on failover) — always target -rw.
#   secret : the k8s Secret holding the DB password (pull per-session; NEVER stored in the connection file).
#            Plain-STS/vendor secrets are Opaque with varying keys — inspect with the discovery one-liner.
